title: GPT-5 names caruncle oncocytoma from slit-lamp photos in two retrospective cases, months after histology
summary: Sassari ophthalmologists gave ChatGPT (GPT-5) slit-lamp photos and brief summaries of two surgically confirmed caruncular oncocytomas; it proposed oncocytoma first in both. Retrospective proof only.
account: Sacchi et al. (Frontiers in Ophthalmology, 24 April 2026) retrospectively analyzed two cases of caruncular oncocytoma that had been excised and confirmed histopathologically. ChatGPT (GPT-5, 2025 version) received only slit-lamp photographs and a brief summary (age, sex, site) and proposed oncocytoma as the primary hypothesis in both, with differentials including papilloma, nevus, squamous cell carcinoma and melanoma. The authors call it a proof of concept that a general-purpose multimodal model can recognize a rare ocular surface tumor, limited by the sample size; an earlier check noted that the analysis was run on 8 September 2025, months after confirmation, with no effect on care. The authors declare no competing interests. The date is the analysis date given in the earlier reason; publication was 24 April 2026.
purpose: Test whether a multimodal large language model can generate diagnostic hypotheses from slit-lamp images
deployer: Department of Medicine, Surgery and Pharmacy, University of Sassari
segment: Patients with rare ocular adnexal tumors (retrospective)
taxonomy_note: A retrospective diagnostic match with no effect on care is read as task performance.

ratings.reason: No effect on the two patients, whose diagnoses were already confirmed.

ai_role.statement: GPT-5 produced the correct primary hypothesis in two retrospective cases when given images and minimal clinical data; the result is a proof of concept reported by non-vendor clinicians and had no role in the patients' management.

evidence.citation: Sacchi M, Ellecosta C, Sechi S, Dore S, Pinna A. Front Ophthalmol 6:1772378 (2026)
evidence.title: Artificial intelligence-assisted diagnosis of ocular caruncle oncocytoma: a proof-of-concept case report of two cases
evidence.quote: In both cases, ChatGPT proposed oncocytoma as the primary diagnostic hypothesis.

produced_by: Slit-lamp photographs plus a brief clinical summary submitted to a multimodal model
must_hold: Prospective testing before any clinical use
